changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: UPDATE process_definition_building_block_definition SET main = true WHERE (process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag) IN ( SELECT process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag FROM ( SELECT link.process_definition_id, link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.version_tag_ = CONCAT('BB:', link.building_block_definition_key, ':', link.building_block_definition_version_tag) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pd.version_ DESC ) AS link_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN link.main THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ) AS has_main FROM process_definition_building_block_definition link JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.link_rank = 1 AND ranked.has_main = 1 )

changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM process_definition_building_block_definition WHERE (process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag) IN ( SELECT process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag FROM ( SELECT link.process_definition_id, link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.version_tag_ = CONCAT('BB:', link.building_block_definition_key, ':', link.building_block_definition_version_tag) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pd.version_ DESC ) AS link_rank FROM process_definition_building_block_definition link JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.link_rank > 1 )

changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: UPDATE process_definition_building_block_definition AS link SET process_definition_id = ( SELECT latest.id_ FROM act_re_procdef linked_pd JOIN act_re_procdef latest ON latest.key_ = linked_pd.key_ WHERE linked_pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id AND latest.version_tag_ = CONCAT('BB:', link.building_block_definition_key, ':', link.building_block_definition_version_tag) ORDER BY latest.version_ DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM act_re_procdef linked_pd JOIN act_re_procdef latest ON latest.key_ = linked_pd.key_ WHERE linked_pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id AND latest.version_tag_ = CONCAT('BB:', link.building_block_definition_key, ':', link.building_block_definition_version_tag) AND latest.version_ > linked_pd.version_ )

changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO process_definition_building_block_definition ( process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag, main ) SELECT candidate.id_, candidate.building_block_definition_key, candidate.building_block_definition_version_tag, false FROM ( SELECT sibling.id_, link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, sibling.key_ ORDER BY sibling.version_ DESC ) AS candidate_rank FROM process_definition_building_block_definition link JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id JOIN act_re_procdef sibling ON sibling.deployment_id_ = pd.deployment_id_ AND sibling.version_tag_ = pd.version_tag_ WHERE pd.version_tag_ = CONCAT('BB:', link.building_block_definition_key, ':', link.building_block_definition_version_tag) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM process_definition_building_block_definition other_link JOIN act_re_procdef other_pd ON other_pd.id_ = other_link.process_definition_id WHERE other_link.building_block_definition_key = link.building_block_definition_key AND other_link.building_block_definition_version_tag = link.building_block_definition_version_tag AND other_pd.key_ = sibling.key_ ) ) candidate WHERE candidate.candidate_rank = 1
